name: Hayami Mikiko
source:
Tabby Lloyd is a reporter who was present at Gourd Lake during the President of Zheng Fa's discourse and attempted assassination.

Lloyd is brash, loud, and determined; personality traits she shares with her mentor [url=http://vndb.org/c14283]Lotta Hart[/url]. She also has a similar style of speech to Hart.

[Edited from [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Mikiko_Hayami]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
